entry.title: Re: Safer sighashes and more granular SIGHASH_NOINPUT
entry.summary:
The development process is currently evaluating various mechanisms for implementing covenants or vaults within blockchain systems, specifically by utilizing platforms like Liquid and Elements. Three primary approaches are under consideration: OP_CHECKSIGFROMSTACK, OP_CHECKOUTPUTVERIFY as initially suggested by Eyal et al., and any additional mechanisms that may prove relevant. The intention behind this exploration is to identify the most effective and practical solution for mainnet deployment, acknowledging that not all features under review will ultimately be adopted.
Among these options, OP_CHECKSIGFROMSTACK stands out as an especially elegant mechanism. Its design potentially offers a streamlined method for enforcing spending conditions on blockchain outputs. Meanwhile, references such as [OP_PUSHTXDATA](https://github.com/ElementsProject/elements/pull/1015) are being studied to further inform the decision-making process and enhance understanding of available alternatives.
A collaborative spirit is encouraged, with openness to suggestions about other covenant or vault mechanisms beyond those already identified. This atmosphere of shared feedback and continuous learning aims to ensure that the final recommendation reflects both technical rigor and community insights.
